fact: Bell Burnell was President of the Royal Astronomical Society (2002-2004), the first female President of the Institute of Physics (October 2008 to October 2010) and the first female President of the Royal Society of Edinburgh (2014-2018). In August 2006 she presided over the IAU's adoption of the resolutions defining 'planet' and 'dwarf planet'. Her thesis adviser was Antony Hewish (spelt Antony).
